Era amaaso gammwe galiraba ne mwogera nti, '
"Omwana assaamu kitaawe ekitiibwa, n'omuddu atya mukama we. Kale obanga ddala ndi kitammwe, ekitiibwa kye munzisaamu kiri ludda wa? Era obanga ndi mukama wammwe, lwaki temuntya?" bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye bw'abagamba mmwe nti, "Mmwe bakabona munyooma erinnya lyange.

Bwe muwaayo ensolo enzibe z'amaaso okuba ssaddaaka, muba temukoze kibi? Ate bwe muwaayo eziwenyera oba endwadde, ekyo si kibi? Kale nno mugezeeko okuzitonera omufuzi wammwe, anaabasanyukira? Ye anaafaayo okukutunulako?" bw'ayogera
"Kale nno mbasaba mwegayirire Katonda, atukwatirwe ekisa, kubanga ebyo ffe twabyereetera. Nga muleese ebiweebwayo ebifaanana bityo, waliwo n'omu gw'ayinza okukkiriza?" bw'ayogera
"Kale waakiri singa omu ku bakabona aggalawo enzigi muleme okukuma omuliro ku kyoto kyange ogw'obwereere! Sibasanyukira n'akatono," bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye, "so sikkirize kiweebwayo kyonna ekiva mu mikono gyammwe.

Kubanga okuva enjuba gy'eva okutuusa gy'egwa erinnya lyange kkulu mu baamawanga; obubaane buweerwayo mu buli kifo eri erinnya lyange, nga kuliko n'ekiweebwayo ekirongoofu, kubanga erinnya lyange kkulu mu baamawanga," bw'ayogera
"Naye mmwe bakabona muvumisa erinnya lyange mu baamawanga buli lukya nga mugamba nti kya Mukama okuwaayo emmere etesaana n'ebiweebwayo ku kyoto kyange.
Era mwogera nti, 'Nga tulabye;' ne mugiwunyako ne mwetamwa, era ne mwesooza," bw'ayogera
"Bwe muleeta ekinyage, n'ekiwenyera, n'ekirwadde, ebyo bye biweebwayo bye mulina okuleeta, mbikkirize?" bw'ayogera
"Buli mulimba yenna akolimirwe, oyo alina ennume mu kisibo kye eyeeyama okugiwaayo nga ssaddaaka eri Mukama naye n'awaayo ekintu ekiriko obulema: kubanga ndi Kabaka mukulu," bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye, "n'erinnya lyange lya ntiisa mu baamawanga."

items.text: "Kale nno, mmwe bakabona, ekiragiro kino kyammwe.
Bwe mutaakyuse ku mpisa zammwe n'engeri zammwe, bwe mutaafeeyo kuwa linnya lyange kitiibwa," bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye, "kale ndibasindikira ekikolimo era emikisa gyammwe girifuuka ekikolimo. Ate ddala mmaze okubakolimira kubanga ebikulu gye ndi temubitaddeeko mwoyo.
"Kale laba, ndibonereza ezzadde lyammwe, mbasiige n'obusa mu maaso, obusa bwa ssaddaaka zammwe, era mbagobewo mu maaso gange.
Olwo lwe mulimanya nga mbawadde ekiragiro kino, endagaano yange ne Leevi eryoke etuukirire," bw'ayogera
"Endagaano eri mu mateeka ago yali egenderedde kuleeta bulamu na mirembe era n'embimuwa asobole okuntya, era n'antya n'ayimirira ng'atya erinnya lyange.
Amateeka ag'amazima gali mu kamwa ke era nga tewali bulimba busangibwa mu kamwa ke. Yatambula nange mu mirembe ne mu butuukirivu era n'aggya bangi mu kibi.
"Kubanga emimwa gy'abasumba gisaana okukuuma eby'amagezi ebya Katonda era abantu basaana okunoonya okutegeera okuva mu bo, kubanga be babaka ba
Naye mwakyama ne muva mu kkubo; mwesittaza bangi olw'ebyo bye muyigiriza; mwayonoona endagaano ya Leevi," bw'ayogera
"Noolwekyo nabafuula ekinyoomebwa era ekisekererwa mu maaso g'abantu bonna olw'obutagoberera makubo gange era musala emisango nga musaliriza."
Okulabula eri Abatali Beesigwa mu Maka
Kale ffenna tetulina kitaffe omu? Si Katonda omu eyatutonda? Lwaki kale tetuli beesigwa eri bantu bannaffe, ne twonoona endagaano ya bakitaffe?
Yuda takuumye bwesigwa n'eby'omuzizo ne bikolebwa mu Isirayiri ne mu Yerusaalemi. Kubanga Yuda yayonoona ekifo kya
ekitukuvu, ky'ayagala ennyo, bwe yawasa omuwala wa lubaale.
Buli muntu yenna akola kino, oba kabona oba muntu wa bulijjo,
alimuggya mu kika kya Yakobo, newaakubadde ng'aleeta ebiweebwayo eri
Ekirala kye mukola kye kino: Ekyoto kya
mukijjuzza amaziga, nga mukaaba nga mukuba ebiwoobe kubanga ebiweebwayo byammwe takyabifaako.
yali mujulirwa wakati wo ne mukazi wo ow'omu buvubuka bwo, naye ggwe tewali mwesigwa, ng'olimbalimba newaakubadde nga yali munno era mukazi wo gwe walagaana naye endagaano.

Katonda teyabafuula omu mu mwoyo? Era lwaki yabafuula omu? Kubanga yali anoonya ezzadde eriritya Katonda. Kale mwekuume nnyo waleme kubaawo agoba mukazi we, era alimbalimba mukazi we ow'omu buvubuka bwe.
Katonda wa Isirayiri, "n'omusajja ajooga mukazi we," bw'ayogera
Kale mwekuumenga mu mwoyo gwammwe mubeerenga beesigwa.
Kubanga mwogera nti buli akola ekibi, mulungi mu maaso ga
, era abasanyukira; oba nti, "Ali ludda wa Katonda ow'obwenkanya?"

items.text: "Laba, ntuma omubaka wange, alinkulembera era alirongoosa ekkubo nga sinnajja: era Mukama gwe munoonya alijja mu yeekaalu ye nga tebamanyiridde; omubaka w'endagaano gwe musanyukira, laba ajja," bw'ayogera
"Naye ani ayinza okugumiikiriza olunaku olw'okujja kwe, era ani aliyimirira ye bw'alirabika? Kubanga ali ng'omuliro gw'oyo alongoosa effeeza era nga sabbuuni ow'abayoza.

Era alituula n'atunula ng'oyo alongoosa ffeeza n'agimalamu amasengere, era alirongoosa batabani ba Leevi, bakabona ba Katonda, era alibasengejja ng'ezaabu n'effeeza bwe bisengejjebwa; balyoke baweeyo ssaddaaka mu butuukirivu.
Awo ekiweebwayo ekya Yuda ne Yerusaalemi kiryoke kisanyuse
, nga mu nnaku ez'edda era nga mu myaka egyayita.

"Era mu kiseera ekyo awatali kulonzalonza ndibasemberera nsale omusango. Ndiyanguwa okuwa obujulizi ku baloga ne ku benzi ne ku abo abalayira eby'obulimba, ne ku abo abalyazaamaanya omupakasi empeera ye; abanyigiriza nnamwandu ne mulekwa, era abajoogereza munnaggwanga, abatatya
sijjulukuka: mmwe, batabani ba Yakobo, noolwekyo siribazikiriza.
Okuva mu nnaku za bajjajjammwe mwakyuka ne mukyama okuva ku biragiro byange ne mutabikwata. Mudde gye ndi, nange nadda gye muli era nnaabasonyiwa," bw'ayogera
"Naye mmwe munnyaga. Kyokka mugamba nti, 'Tukunyaga tutya?'
Mukolimiddwa ekikolimo ekyo, kubanga mmwe, eggwanga lyonna munnyaga nze.
Muleete ekimu eky'ekkumi ekijjuvu mu nnyumba yange, ennyumba yange ebeeremu emmere, era mungezese," bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye, "obanga siribaggulirawo ebituli eby'omu ggulu, ne mbawa omukisa ne gutabaako ne we guligya.
Kale ndikuuma ennimiro zammwe ne zitazikirizibwa balabe; so n'omuzabbibu gwammwe ne gutakunkumula bibala byagwo ebitannatuuka kwengera," bw'ayogera
"Era amawanga gonna galibayita ba mukisa: kubanga muliba nsi esanyusa, kino ky'ekisuubizo," bw'ayogera
"Weewaawo ebigambo byammwe gye ndi bibadde bya bukambwe," bw'ayogera
"Mwayogera nti, 'Eby'okuweereza Katonda tebigasa, era kigasa ki okukwata ebiragiro bye era n'okutambulira mu maaso ga
Okuva kaakano abeegulumiza tubayita ba mukisa; abakozi b'ebibi bakulaakulana era n'abo abasoomoza Katonda nabo bawona.' "
ne balowooza ku linnya lye, ne kiwandiikibwa ng'alaba.
ow'Eggye, "ku lunaku lwe ndibakyusizaako okuba ekintu kyange eky'omuwendo; era ndibasonyiwa ng'omuzadde bw'asonyiwa mutabani we amuweereza.
Omulundi omulala mulyawula omutuukirivu n'omubi, oyo aweereza Katonda n'oyo atamuweereza."

items.text: "Kubanga, laba, olunaku lujja, lwokya ng'ekikoomi, n'ab'amalala bonna n'abo bonna abakola ebibi baliba bisasiro: ku lunaku lwennyini balyokerwa ddala," bw'ayogera
Naye mmwe abatya erinnya lyange, enjuba ey'obutuukirivu eribaviirayo ng'erina okuwonya mu biwaawaatiro byayo. Mulifuluma ne muligita ng'ennyana ez'omu kiraalo.
Era mulirinnya ku babi, kubanga baliba vvu wansi w'ebigere byammwe, ku lunaku lwe ndibalokolerako," bw'ayogera
"Mujjukire okugonderanga amateeka ga Musa omuddu wange, ebiragiro n'amateeka bye namukwasa ku Kolebu olwa Isirayiri yenna.
